title: Linearized Boundary Control Method for Damping Reconstruction in an Acoustic Inverse Boundary Value Problem
summary: We develop a linearized boundary control method for the inverse boundary value problem of determining the damping coefficient in the damped wave equation. The objective is to reconstruct an unknown perturbation in a known background damping from the linearized Neumann-to-Dirichlet map. When the linearization is at a constant background damping, we derive a reconstructive algorithm with stability estimates based on the boundary control method in dimension $n\geq 1$.
